item.title: Talyllyn offer women free tickets for International Women’s Day
item.description: The Talyllyn Railway is celebrating International Women's Day 2026 (Sunday, 8th March) and is inviting women to join the day.

item.title: Original Swanage Railway restoration volunteers gather in Dorset for fiftieth anniversary
item.description: The volunteers who, as teenagers, began working to restore the Swanage Railway in 1976 have gathered to celebrate its fiftieth anniversary.

item.title: New Northumberland railway station given green light
item.description: Northumberland Park Station in North Tyneside has received the green light from the Office of Rail and Road (ORR) and will open to passengers on Sunday, 22 February. It is the fifth of six stations to be completed on the Northumberland Line, with Bedlington Station, the final stop, expected to open in March 2026.

item.title: Greater Manchester communities given public consult for future plans
item.description: Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) is encouraging residents to have their say with a public consultation on upcoming major plans to shape the future of local transport for their communities stretching forward into 2050.

item.title: HST power car arrives ahead of Nene Valley Diesel Gala
item.description: Wansford Motive Power Depot (MPD), on the Nene Valley Railway, had an exciting arrival yesterday.

item.title: Lappa Valley welcomes the first train to its new platform
item.description: The Lappa Valley Railway has welcomed the first train to arrive at the newly built platform, officially opening the first addition to the Main Railway in more than four decades.

item.title: Mark 4 coaches enter preservation with new deal
item.description: Beacon Rail and 225 Preservation CIC have reached an agreement that sees two Mark 4 coaches enter preservation.

item.title: East Midlands Railway urges passengers to plan ahead amid busy weekend plans
item.description: East Midlands Railway (EMR) is warning passengers of extremely busy services this weekend as major engineering work affects the East Coast Main Line and the approach to Manchester Piccadilly. While these upgrades will improve reliability in the long term, travel this weekend will be disrupted.

item.title: Services in East Midlands to be affected this weekend
item.description: This weekend, buses will replace trains while Network Rail upgrades the track between Melton Mowbray and Syston East Junction.
